newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha strengthens, sellers in bullish mood.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha strengthens, sellers in bullish mood.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices continued to strengthen on Tuesday as firm gasoline prices and perceptions of fresh demand fueled a bullish mood, traders said.
However, trade was thin European end-users purported to be relaxed, saying their needs were little more than for top-up parcels for the moment.

Despite this sellers continued to hike offers and swaps reflected their firmer sentiment, trading at $230 for the balance of Jan on perceptions that the petrochemical companies would need to start covering again soon.
Physical cargoes were notionally valued around $228.
